card.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
card.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: These minutes say 'discussion of my proposal.' What did you leave out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sign them and we can eat. Nobody wanted an awkward record.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Nobody' sounds crowded. Who wanted my name out of it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did. I suggested someone else present, to save your proposal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who else? You've recorded my rescue very carefully without naming my replacement.

mechanism: A probes tactful meeting minutes and protective explanations until the omitted person and judgment are named.
confusable: Unlike proofreading a record, A must treat each careful answer as evidence of further withholding.
comparison: D102-b follows vague nobody into a replacement question; D102-a follows interesting into a performance-gap question.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
